task: LinkedIn (the person's own account): request LinkedIn's official data export of Connections, so the CSV can be imported into the BehalfBot CRM. Uses LinkedIn's own 'Get a copy of your data' feature, no scraping

steps.human: Make sure you are signed in to LinkedIn in this tab. Press Done when you see 'Get a copy of your data'.

steps.do: Choose 'Want something in particular? Select the data files you're most interested in' and tick Connections only. Do not request the full archive.

steps.human: Check that only Connections is ticked. Press Request archive yourself (re-enter your password if asked), then Done.

steps.do: Report the status LinkedIn shows (usually ready within about 10 minutes, sent to the account email). Stop there.

accept: LinkedIn shows a pending or ready Connections export. The person downloads the zip from LinkedIn's email and sends Connections.csv to Jax for the CRM import.
notes: Never open messaging, profiles of other people or search: only the settings data-export page.
No scraping and no paging through connections: LinkedIn's own export avoids the anti-automation risk.
The download happens outside the extension; nothing is saved by the driver.
